deliverables: Frontend maintenance and cross-platform development for web, browser extension, Android, and iOS
Backend infrastructure and operations including servers, Cardano nodes, DBSync/indexers, application services, monitoring, alerting, and incident response
User support through Discord, Telegram, public channels, ecosystem project support, wiki updates, and educational videos
Governance tooling enhancements including DRep dashboards, proposal browsers, in-wallet voting, and proposal creation
Eternl Core rewrite, Eternl Hub, enhanced hardware wallet support, and enhanced wallet data export
Periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, development, support, audits, and administration from August 2026 to July 2027.

claims.claim: Eternl is a non-custodial Cardano light wallet for web, browser extension, Android, and iOS used for payments, staking, governance, and DApp interaction.
The proposal requests ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover an annual operating cost of about $420,000.
The proposal funds 6.0 FTE distributed across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.

Eternl plans to introduce Pro plans priced at $96 per year for personal users and $360 per year for companies, and estimates that about 5,500 users, or 4.2% of its install base, would cover the $420,000 annual cost.
Eternl reports an install base of about 100,000 browser-extension users and about 30,000 Android and iOS users.
After withdrawal, the proposer says it will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, deposit it into a public company wallet, and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.

The proposer commits to independent treasury-use audits in February 2027 and August 2027 covering custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro plan income relevant to repayment, and refunds or repayments.

Every December and June, the proposer says surplus treasury stablecoins plus paid-plan income above $420,000 will be used for treasury repayment until $420,000 in Ada is repaid, followed by possible additional donations capped at $210,000 worth of Ada.
The proposer states that 10-18% of Mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.

The proposer states that without treasury funding, insufficient license sales beyond August could require developer layoffs, scaling Eternl down to essential maintenance, shifting focus outside Cardano, and possibly removing the free option.

summary: The document asks for ₳2,350,000 for Tastenkunst GmbH/Eternl to fund 12 months of wallet operations and development, with a stated $420,000 annual cost, a planned Pro subscription path to sustainability, public wallet custody, independent fund-use audits, and conditional treasury repayment mechanisms.
